Strategy: Score each bin by triangular distance from a target leftover of half the item size, preferring bins whose post-placement residual lands nearest item/2. Bins leaving almost nothing or a very large gap score worse, so the choice differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin leaves far less than item/2 while a looser bin lands near the peak. This may preserve near-empty bins for tiny future items, but can waste tight fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs((r - item) - item / 2) for r in bins]
```
